item.title: Fijiana XV fall 55-12 to clinical Springbok Women
item.description: The Vodafone Fijiana XV went down 55-12 to a clinical Springbok women in their inaugral Ubuntu-Bula Trophy game at the HFC Bank Stadium this afternoon. There were moments of indiscipline for the Fijiana as they spent 20 minutes a player down after No. 8 Alfreda Fisher was yellow carded, which was later upgraded to red for diving in at the ruck and catching the opposing player on the head.
item.content:encoded:
The Vodafone Fijiana XV went down 55-12 to a clinical Springbok women in their inaugral Ubuntu-Bula Trophy game at the HFC Bank Stadium this afternoon.

There were moments of indiscipline for the Fijiana as they spent 20 minutes a player down after No. 8 Alfreda Fisher was yellow carded, which was later upgraded to red for diving in at the ruck and catching the opposing player on the head.

The South Africans ran in 10 tries to the Fijiana's two tries from Adi Vani Buleki and Varanisese Qoro.

Captain Kelera Lomani says their collision let them down today.

Lomani says they will go back and review the footage to see what they can improve on before next week's game.

She also thanked the fans that came out to support them, as well for the love and support they have for the Fijiana team.

The Springbok women led 27-7 at the break.

The two sides will face off again next week at Churchill Park, Lautoka for their second Test.

item.title: QVS, RKS, MGM and Ratu Navula through to U14 Super Deans semi-finals
item.description: In the first round of the Vodafone Super Deans National Quarterfinals at the HFC Bank Stadium, the Queen Victoria School U14 side demolished Nasinu 32-0. In other U14 matches, Ratu Kadavulevu School beat Suva Grammar School 11-0, Mahatma Gandhi Memorial High School thrashed Nadi Muslim 36-14, while Ratu Navula outplayed Lelean Memorial School 27-12.
item.content:encoded:
In the first round of the Vodafone Super Deans National Quarterfinals at the HFC Bank Stadium, the Queen Victoria School U14 side demolished Nasinu 32-0.

In other U14 matches, Ratu Kadavulevu School beat Suva Grammar School 11-0, Mahatma Gandhi Memorial High School thrashed Nadi Muslim 36-14, while Ratu Navula outplayed Lelean Memorial School 27-12.

In the U15 grade it went down to the wire as QVS and Suva Grammar School were locked nil-all at halftime.

Both teams then scored a try each, with QVS stealing the win in the dying seconds of the game with a penalty to win it 10-8.

In the U15 grade that was played at Garvey Park, Tavua where Marist Brothers High School edged Natabua High School 13-10.

In the Weetbix Raluve U16 grade, Adi Cakobau School beat St Theresa 12-10.

Stay with us as we will bring you the latest results.

item.title: TISA Insurance backs Team Moce ahead of Super 8 Cricket Championship
item.description: Team Moce has received a sponsorship boost from TISA Insurance ahead of the Super 8 Cricket Championship, which will be held from 11th to 15th this month at Albert Park in Suva. TISA Insurance handed over its sponsorship to Team Moce, including a team tent and other essential equipment to support the team during the tournament.
item.content:encoded:
Team Moce has received a sponsorship boost from TISA Insurance ahead of the Super 8 Cricket Championship, which will be held from 11th to 15th this month at Albert Park in Suva.

TISA Insurance handed over its sponsorship to Team Moce, including a team tent and other essential equipment to support the team during the tournament.

The handover was attended by Moce Cricket Association coach Sisaro Dautu, Team Moce representatives and TISA Insurance's Manager Marketing and Business Development, Bhavik Chand, who represented Chief Executive Officer David Ariff Chan.

Speaking during the handover, TISA Insurance's Manager Marketing and Business Development Bhavik Chand says TISA Insurance believes investing in grassroots sport is an investment in communities.

He says the company is proud to support Team Moce and looks forward to seeing them compete against some of Fiji's best cricket teams.

Chand also says TISA Insurance will officially hand over its sponsorship to Team Namuka-i-Lau next week as they prepare for the championship.

The Super 8 Cricket Championship Group A features Kabara, Lakeba, Moce and Namuka-i-Lau , while Group B consists of Suva, Nadi, Ono-i-Lau and Komo .

item.title: Wailevu cruises past Batinikama 2-0 in Vanua Levu Muslim IDC opener
item.description: Mohammed Feroz , Nilufa Buksh · 08/08/2026 Wailevu beat Batinikama 3-0 in the opening Premier Division match of the Matuk Motor Spares Vanua Levu Muslim IDC tournament yesterday at Subrail Park in Labasa.
item.content:encoded:
Mohammed Feroz , Nilufa Buksh · 08/08/2026

Wailevu beat Batinikama 3-0 in the opening Premier Division match of the Matuk Motor Spares Vanua Levu Muslim IDC tournament yesterday at Subrail Park in Labasa.

Both teams started strongly, but Wailevu soon took control through the experience of former Dreketi and Labasa representative Mohammed Shaheel Yaseen, who dictated play in midfield and created several opportunities for his side.

Wailevu's well-structured attacking play paid off as they scored three unanswered goals to secure a comfortable victory.

Despite the loss, Batinikama showed promise with their young squad but were unable to convert their chances.

Speaking to fijivillage News after the match, Wailevu captain Mohammed Shaheel Yaseen praised his teammates for their performance.

Yaseen says the team played well and scoring the opening goal early gave them confidence.

He says they will now turn their attention to their next match against Vunimoli and prepare well for the challenge.

Yaseen says it has been a long time since Wailevu last won the Premier Division title, and the team is determined to give its best and bring the trophy back home.

Wailevu will take on Vunimoli in their next Premier Division match as they continue their quest for the championship.

Meanwhile, in other matches Valebasoga defeated Vunimoli 1-0 in the Premier Division, while Nasea and Soasoa played out a goalless draw in the Super Premier Division.

item.title: Super 8 Championship draw sets stage for title race
item.description: The battle for Cricket Fiji's 2026 Super 8 Championship title has officially begun, with the tournament draw held today and the eight qualifying teams discovering their group opponents. Group A features Kabara, Lakeba, Moce and Namuka-i-Lau , while Group B consists of Suva, Nadi, Ono-i-Lau and Komo .
item.content:encoded:
The battle for Cricket Fiji's 2026 Super 8 Championship title has officially begun, with the tournament draw held today and the eight qualifying teams discovering their group opponents.

Group A features Kabara, Lakeba, Moce and Namuka-i-Lau , while Group B consists of Suva, Nadi, Ono-i-Lau and Komo .

The championship will be held from 11th to 15th August at Albert Park in Suva , with free entry for spectators.

The Super 8 Championship will see the country's top teams compete for national honours over five days of competition.
